profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Southeast Christian Church
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years in tech, building software that solves real problems and helping the people around me make better decisions about which problems are worth solving.

Most recently I've been leading engineering at a large nonprofit organization to modernize our software development lifecycle around agentic AI workflows (not just using AI as a coding assistant, but building systems where AI participates meaningfully in spec creation, documentation, code review, and CI/CD pipelines). Beyond production tooling, I actively experiment with local model deployment, multimodal pipelines, and custom multi-model orchestration because understanding how these systems actually work makes me a better engineer when applying them.

On the technical side I work across the full stack: C#/.NET, React/Next.js, and .NET MAUI for mobile, and I've led security auditing and vulnerability remediation across a large plugin ecosystem. I care about writing software that is maintainable, well-documented, secure, and built with the next engineer in mind.

I'm equally comfortable writing code, reviewing architecture, mentoring teammates, or sitting across from a non-technical stakeholder and helping them figure out what they actually need.

positions.title: Client Engineer I
positions.description:
- Monitored and troubleshot customer network environments, including routers, connectivity, and voice/data services.
- Remotely configured and managed customer routers to diagnose and resolve network outages, routing issues, and service degradation.
- Investigated incidents using network monitoring and diagnostic tools, isolating problems across customer equipment, provider circuits, and upstream infrastructure.
- Collaborated with Internet service providers and telecommunications carriers to escalate circuit issues, coordinate testing, and restore service.
- Maintained clear incident documentation and communicated technical findings, resolution steps, and service-impact information to internal and external stakeholders.
- Responded to network incidents in a fast-paced operations environment where timely diagnosis and service continuity were critical.
